prompt.value: Let $A$ be a $3 \times 3$ matrix of rank 2. What is the dimension of the null space (nullity) of $A$?
Let $W$ be the subspace of $\mathbb{R}^4$ defined by $W = \{(x_1, x_2, x_3, x_4) \in \mathbb{R}^4 : x_1 + x_2 + x_3 + x_4 = 0 \text{ and } x_1 - x_4 = 0\}$. What is the dimension of $W$?

explanation.value: Two linearly independent linear constraints on $\mathbb{R}^4$ yield a subspace of dimension $4 - 2 = 2$.

prompt.value:
Consider the matrix:
$$A = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 4 & -1 & 3 \\ 5 & 2 & 7 & 1 \\ 7 & k_1 & 15 & k_2 \end{bmatrix}$$
If the rank of $A$ is 2, find the value of $k_1$.

explanation.value: Row 3 must be a linear combination of Row 1 and Row 2. $R_3 = -R_1 + 2R_2$. For column 2: $k_1 = -1(4) + 2(2) = 0$.

Let $W = \{(x, y) \in \mathbb{R}^2 : x > 0, y > 0\}$. Define vector addition $\oplus$ and scalar multiplication $\odot$ on $W$ by:
$$(x_1, y_1) \oplus (x_2, y_2) = (x_1 x_2, y_1 y_2)$$
$$c \odot (x, y) = (x^c, y^c) \quad \text{for } c \in \mathbb{R}$$
What is the additive identity (zero vector) of the vector space $(W, \oplus, \odot)$?

explanation.value: For any $(x, y) \in W$, $(x, y) \oplus (e_1, e_2) = (x e_1, y e_2) = (x, y) \implies e_1 = 1, e_2 = 1$.

prompt.value:
Let $W = \{(x, y) \in \mathbb{R}^2 : x > 0, y > 0\}$ be the vector space over $\mathbb{R}$ with operations:
$$(x_1, y_1) \oplus (x_2, y_2) = (x_1 x_2, y_1 y_2) \quad \text{and} \quad c \odot (x, y) = (x^c, y^c)$$
What is the dimension of this vector space $W$?

explanation.value: Under the coordinate map $(x, y) \mapsto (\ln x, \ln y)$, $W$ is isomorphic to the standard vector space $\mathbb{R}^2$, so $\dim(W) = 2$.
